defects: The production captures show the metal stand with no fabric hammock between the supports.
Without the sling, the asset does not read as a complete hammock.
incumbent_comparison: First production candidate. The metal stand is visible, but the required sling does not appear in any captured view.
likely_causes: Godot rejected the generator's untyped color array at the Array[Color] function boundary; the wrapper returned exit code zero even though the sling builder stopped before adding canvas meshes.
next_action_hypothesis: Pass a typed Array[Color] into the sling builder, require the expected number of generated canvas meshes, and rerender the production scene to verify the textile is visible.

observations.art_direction_fit: The dark stand and neutral palette fit the room, but the missing main fabric surface leaves the visual target unmet.
observations.close_up_quality: The detailed capture looks at the room wall and stand edge rather than a fabric surface, so the required textile is not shown.
observations.gameplay_readability: The stand is visible in the room, but the absent hammock fabric makes the intended object incomplete.
observations.geometric_detail: The stand has paired angled legs and end braces; the expected suspension canvas and visible end details are not present in the images.
observations.material_realism: The dark metal frame reads as metal, while the fabric material cannot be evaluated because the sling is invisible.
observations.proportion: The support span and stand height appear consistent with a long room-scale hammock.
observations.scale_fidelity: Godot technical validation passed for the 118 x 40 x 34-inch target envelope.
observations.semantic_recognizability: The close view shows a long dark frame, but the missing sling prevents a clear hammock reading.
observations.silhouette_quality: The end supports and tension rails make a long freestanding frame silhouette; the sling shape is absent.
observations.surface_variation: The frame has little visible surface variation and none from the missing striped sling.
observations.technical_integration: The native scene passes technical validation and the production resolver loaded hammock_with_stand-v001 for six real RoomScale captures.
